metric_definitions.mean_normalized_wer: Mean per-recording Levenshtein word error rate after lowercase, punctuation, common-unit, and selected transliteration normalization; scores can exceed 1.0.
metric_definitions.mean_target_term_recall: Mean per-recording fraction of manifest target terms matched with clinical aliases after normalization; parenthetical and semicolon-separated alternatives are accepted.
metric_definitions.mean_mwer: Medical Term Error Rate: 1 minus per-recording target-term recall, averaged across the 15 cases.
metric_definitions.stream_segment_loss: Not measured by this offline transcript benchmark.

models_evaluated.name: Meta Wav2Vec2 Base 960h (English)
models_evaluated.language_limitation: English-only checkpoint; not an Amharic/code-switch model.

models_not_scored.name: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-transcribe
models_not_scored.reason: The recorded run metadata reports HTTP 429; partial output is excluded from comparative scores.

limitations: This is a 15-case simulated Amharic-English dataset and is not a population-level clinical performance estimate.
The manifest annotator_count field is blank.
The audio files are not included in the public repository, so transcript scoring is reproducible from the manifest but model inference cannot be independently rerun from this checkout.
Wav2Vec2 Base 960h is English-only and is included as a limited baseline.
No ASR-FAIRBENCH analysis, subgroup fairness result, hallucination rate, or streaming segment-loss result is claimed.
